d:
Kushina Uzumaki is a powerful kunoichi from the Uzumaki Clan in Naruto. She was born in Uzushiogakure and later moved to Konohagakure, where she became the second jinchūriki of the Nine-Tails, Kurama.
She was known for her fiery personality, incredible chakra, strong will, and distinctive red hair. Kushina was also the wife of Minato Namikaze and the mother of Naruto Uzumaki.
Despite her difficult life, Kushina remained loving and determined. Her final words and love for Naruto became one of the most emotional moments in the series. ❤️‍🔥🍥
Japanese: うずまきクシナ (Uzumaki Kushina)
Clan: Uzumaki Clan
Village: Konohagakure
Son: Naruto Uzumaki
Husband: Minato Namikaze
Known for: Nine-Tails Jinchūriki, Adamantine Sealing Chains
